title: ROBBIE: Robust Bias Evaluation of Large Generative Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model continuations to age-related prompts using automated classifiers to measure rates of toxicity and negative regard, and calculating bias as the downward shift from an acceptable background rate.
Prompting generative language models with body type-related terms and analyzing the generated text for toxicity and negative regard using automated classifiers.
Measuring the frequency of toxic or negative regard generations when models are prompted with text containing socioeconomic class identifiers.
Generating text continuations from culture-specific prompts and scoring them for toxicity and negative regard to calculate demographic parity differences.
Evaluating the responses of models to prompts containing physical and mental disability identifiers, scoring the outputs for negative regard and toxicity.
Using datasets like AdvPromptSet and HolisticBiasR to inject gender and sex identifiers into prompts, subsequently measuring the toxicity and negative regard in the generated outputs.
Assessing model outputs triggered by nationality-specific terms to determine the rate at which they exceed a baseline acceptable threshold for negative regard and toxicity.
Testing language models on occupation-based prompt datasets (such as BOLD) and evaluating the resulting text using automated safety classifiers.
Evaluating model continuations generated from prompts mentioning various political ideologies, measuring the rates of negative regard and toxicity.
Using demographic term replacement in prompts to measure how often models produce toxic or negative text for specific racial and ethnic subgroups compared to a baseline.
Analyzing generated text for toxicity and negative regard when language models are prompted with identifiers from different religious groups.
Scoring the toxicity and negative regard of model generations prompted by terminology associated with various sexual orientations.

Using the novel AdvPromptSet dataset to evaluate model generations when prompted with combinations of multiple demographic identities (e.g., race and gender, gender and sexuality) to identify compounded toxicity and negative regard.
